description: Enrich a company domain into structured firmographics: employee band, industry, HQ, founded year, revenue estimate, logo, and description, with source provenance. Parsed from the company's schema.org/Organization JSON-LD and HTML meta tags and returned as a flat, Clay-ready JSON row with a source_signals array and a data_completeness score. Reads public data and writes nothing; requires an APIFY_TOKEN and consumes Apify credits per call.

batchSize.description: Domains enriched concurrently per wave in batch mode. Default 5, maximum 10.

company_name.description: Optional company name, used as a fallback label when the page does not expose one.

domain.description: Bare company domain to enrich, e.g. stripe.com. Provide this or domains.

domains.description: List of bare domains for batch processing. Takes precedence over domain.

max_charge_usd.description: Optional spending cap for this call, in USD, passed to the actor as max_charge_usd. The run stops before any charge that would take it past this amount and keeps every row already charged. Leave empty to rely only on the maximum charge per run set on your Apify account.

skipCache.description: Force a fresh enrichment and ignore the 7 day result cache.

name: enrich_company_firmographics
title: Enrich Company Firmographics
